description: This file defines environment and path management utilities for the OpenClaw application, including environment variable overrides, directory paths, config file resolution, and workspace directory access.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Provides the URL to the application's state directory, considering environment variable overrides.

methods.name: resolveConfigCandidate
methods.description: Finds the first existing configuration file (like 'openclaw.json') in a given directory.

methods.name: configURL
methods.description: Determines the application's configuration file URL, prioritizing environment overrides, then existing config files, or defaults.

methods.name: workspaceURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the workspace directory within the state directory.
